description: Rave hoover riff in A Phrygian at 160 BPM: stab rhythm on power chords, wide detune, a smooth dive and a long hold at the end.
Uplifting trance hook in A minor at 138 BPM: one rhythm every bar, a rising call and a falling answer over Am, F, C, G, with offbeat bass underneath.
Slow, wide analog style pad chords, no effects needed.
House organ chord melody at 124 BPM over Am7, Dm7, G7, Cmaj7: one syncopated stab rhythm every bar, a top note melody, the last stab pushing into the next chord, funk bass under it.
Rolling offbeat trance bass on A, F, C and G.
Squelchy acid line in A minor at 132 BPM: 16 steps, accents on the strong steps, octave jumps and a climb in the last bar.
Soft house chords at 122 BPM over Dm9, G7, Cmaj9, Am9: syncopated stabs with a melody on top and a light bass.
Trance pluck arpeggio at 138 BPM over a warm pad: Am, F, C, G with accents on every third and second sixteenth.
Wide string section at 108 BPM: Am, F, C, G, Am with a rising top line that lands back on A.
Rave brass stabs at 128 BPM in A minor: one stab rhythm every bar, a funk bass locked to the hits, ending on a long chord.
Bell melody at 112 BPM over a glass pad: a short call and answer in A minor that resolves on A.
Slow choir chords at 112 BPM: Am, F, C, G, Am with smooth voice leading.
Funk clav riff in E dorian at 104 BPM: ghost notes, a chord hit, bass on the strong steps and a climb in the last bar.
